title: SocialReasonBench: A Video-QA Benchmark for Social Reasoning with Counterfactual Narrative Videos
reasoning: The paper introduces 'SocialReasonBench', a benchmark for evaluating social reasoning in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). One of its seven core reasoning dimensions is 'Moral Dilemma', which evaluates how models handle morally consequential decisions involving competing values and obligations, grounded in moral psychology and Moral Foundations Theory.
